nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a finite simple group that has a strongly embedded subgroup $M$. Then $X$ is a simple Bender group: $X$ is isomorphic to $\mathrm{PSL}(2, 2^n)$ for some $n \ge 2$, to the Suzuki group $\mathrm{Sz}(2^{2n+1})$ for some $n \ge 1$, or to $\mathrm{PSU}(3, 2^n)$ for some $n \ge 2$.
nodes.title: Bender–Suzuki theorem

nodes.summary: A group $G$ is a simple Bender group if it is isomorphic to $\mathrm{PSL}(2, 2^n)$ for some $n \ge 2$, to the Suzuki group $\mathrm{Sz}(2^{2n+1})$ for some $n \ge 1$, or to $\mathrm{PSU}(3, 2^n)$ for some $n \ge 2$.
nodes.title: Simple Bender groups

nodes.summary: A subgroup $M$ of a group $X$ is strongly embedded in $X$ if $M \ne X$, the order of $M$ is even, and for every $g \in X$ outside $M$ the order of $M \cap g M g^{-1}$ is odd. Here an infinite group is assigned order $0$, so an infinite $M$ counts as having even order and an infinite intersection never has odd order.
nodes.title: Strongly embedded subgroups

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n \ge 1$, $\mathrm{PSL}(2, 2^n)$ is the projective special linear group of $2 \times 2$ matrices over the Galois field $\mathrm{GF}(2^n)$. For $n = 0$ the same construction is taken over $\mathrm{GF}(2)$ instead.
nodes.title: The group $\mathrm{PSL}(2, 2^n)$

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$, let $q = 2^n$ and let $J$ be the $3 \times 3$ matrix with ones on the antidiagonal and zeros elsewhere. nodes.title: The group $\mathrm{PSU}(3, 2^n)$

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number, $q = 2^{2n+1}$, $\theta = 2^{n+1}$ and $F = \mathrm{GF}(q)$. The generating set of $\mathrm{Sz}(q)$ is the set of $4 \times 4$ matrices over $F$ of the following three kinds: for $a, b \in F$, the root element with rows $(1, a, b, a^{2+\theta} + ab + b^{\theta})$, $(0, 1, a^{\theta}, a^{1+\theta} + b)$, $(0, 0, 1, a)$ and $(0, 0, 0, 1)$; for nonzero $x \in F$, the torus element with…
nodes.title: Generators of the Suzuki group

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the Suzuki group $\mathrm{Sz}(2^{2n+1})$ is the subgroup of $\mathrm{GL}(4, \mathrm{GF}(2^{2n+1}))$ generated by the matrices in the generating set of the Suzuki group (all of which are invertible).
nodes.title: The Suzuki group $\mathrm{Sz}(2^{2n+1})$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
